name: hunter
pixel_processing: Original assembled PNGs only; exact half-scale premultiplied-alpha Lanczos resize, transparent trim, duplicate bitmap sharing, atlas packing. No generated or redrawn artwork.
foot_point_method: For each action the first original PNG is used. Within its recorded foot ROI, measure the bottom alpha row and the midpoint of occupied pixels in the bottom 20 pixels. ROIs exclude the bone weapon, which extends below the soles. One fixed pivot is kept for the whole action. These are reproducible alignment anchors, not unavailable original PAM pivots.

damage_art.note: The package has separate limb pieces, but no original PAM rig/event data and no assembled armless walking/eating/throwing sequences. No such missing sequences were fabricated.

throw_release.basis: Visual inspection: frame 25 still holds the snowball; frame 26 first shows the forward hand empty. This is an integration event inferred from existing images, not a recovered original PAM command.
throw_release.hand_point_basis: Approximate center of the forward hand in source throw0026.png; image registration only.

audio_limitations: The source identifies throwing effort, snowball release, snowball hit and death audio. No separately identified Hunter idle/walking groan clip was found; throw effort/death clips are not relabelled as idle groans.

timing.note: Each PNG frame has a corresponding GIF frame. This preserves the uploader preview timing, not an unprovided original PAM event track.
